item.title: Recurrences for permutations with long increasing subsequences
item.description: arXiv:2609.02220v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove two simple bivariate recurrences for the number of permutations with a long increasing subsequence. The two recurrences imply D-finiteness of the sequence in a certain range. As a consequence, we also obtain a proof of a conjecture posed by Kauers and Koutschan in 2023.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Kauers, Chen Wang
